---
name: New question suggestion
about: Suggest a new interview question (and ideally an answer) to add
title: "[New Question] "
labels: new-question
---

**Category**
Which existing category does this belong in? (e.g., "3. Data Integration & Enterprise Systems"). If you think it needs a new category, say so.

**Suggested difficulty**
🟢 Foundational / 🟡 Intermediate / 🔴 Advanced

**Question**
The question text.

**Suggested answer (optional but appreciated)**
Your draft answer. Practical, experience-grounded answers are especially valued for this repo, given how much this role varies by company and industry.

**Why this question is worth including**
Briefly, why this is a good/representative question for this role.
